publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, we designed single band tunable metamaterial absorber (MMA), which includes of periodic array cube ferrites and metal ground plane. The cube ferrite act as resonant cell, when incident electromagnetic wave and applied magnetic field are all together act on absorber, cube ferrite can produce ferromagnetic resonance (FMR) under some condition, which result in the perfect absorption. By simulation, we obtain single absorption peak with absorptivity of 98% at 8.5GHz. Our work provides new ideas and methods for future studies of absorbers with all-ferrite structures and expands the application of conventional material.

articleTitle: Simulation of graphene-GaAs Schottky junction solar cell with graphene gate by finite difference method
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: Simulation of graphene-GaAs Schottky junction solar cell with graphene gate is performed by using finite difference method. Poisson and driftdiffusion equations are solved self-consistently to capture carrier dynamics in the solar cell. Our algorithm is verified by comparing with experimental results. The Schottky barrier between graphene and GaAs can be tuned by graphene gate, and hence the open circuit voltage is tunable due to the tunability of Schottky barrier. The carrier recombination in GaAs leads to loss of light generated carriers.

articleTitle: Backscattering characteristics of foam-containing sea surface by SSA and VRT
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: Foam on the sea surface affected by wind speed is considered as one of the reasons for sea peak, which increases the risk of radar false alarm. In this paper, a foam-containing sea surface is chosen as a geometrical model solved by small slope approximation (SSA) and vector radiation transfer (VRT). The backscattering characteristics of the foam layer were calculated using VRT, and SSA was employed to investigate HH and VV backscattering characteristics for different frequencies and wind speeds. Results show that the foam layer has a significant effect on the backscattering of the sea surface.

articleTitle: Passive millimeter wave imaging system for public security check
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: A simple, fast, and efficient single channel passive millimeter wave (PMMW) imaging system for public security check was presented in this paper. It distinguishes itself with traditional ones by an innovative scanning structure. Indoor and outdoor experiments against human body with or without hidden items in clothes showed that imaging could be completed in 3–5s with angular resolution of about 0.7°. In addition, its field of view (FOV) was adjustable according to the size of actual target.

articleTitle: ISAR imaging based on divariate empirical mode decomposition and Wigner-Ville Distribution
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: An Inverse Synthetic Aperture Radar (ISAR) imaging method based on Bivariate Empirical Mode Decomposition (BEMD) and Wigner-Ville Distribution (WVD) is proposed in this paper. This method effectively reduces the cross-term interference and has less false frequency, leading to better quality of reconstructed image. Simulation results verify the better performance of proposed BEMD-WVD method compared with WVD method and Complex Empirical Mode Decomposition (CEMD) with WVD (CEMD-WVD) method.

articleTitle: Water-based metamaterial absorber for broadband electromagnetic wave absorption
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: Water occurring on earth has always been equipped with the characteristic of frequency dispersive permittivity at microwave frequency, which thus can be seen as a promising constituent material for broadband electromagnetic wave absorption. Here, we develop water as ultrathin dielectric substrate standing on the metal backplane to construct three-dimensional grid array, which can acquire broadband electromagnetic wave absorption. Meanwhile, when loading metallic isosceles trapezoid fishbone with nearly zero thickness to one side of each water substrate, the broadband absorption of the improved metamaterial absorber will further expand to low frequencies.

articleTitle: A broadband metamaterial absorber based on spatial dispersion engineering of spoof magnetic plasmons
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: This paper presents a design of broadband metamaterial absorbers based on spatially dispersive split ring resonators (SRRs). Because of negative permeability of SRRs, magnetic surface plasmons (SPs) are realized based on SRRs for s-polarized waves. And then, by spatially dispersion engineering, a serially structure of SRRs with heights variation is designed to realize a broadband absorber. The simulation shows that the frequency band of the absorber could be controlled by the height of SRRs delicately.

articleTitle: Anti-jamming of Beidou navigation based on polarization sensitive array
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: Polarization sensitive arrays can suppress the interferences by taking advantage of differences in polarization domain while the interferences and desired signals are from the same direction. In this paper, a 4-element dual-linear-polarized array is used to realize the anti-jamming function in joint spatial-time-polarization domain. A Right-Hand Circular Polarization (RHCP) constraint is added to the Linear Constraints Minimum Variance (LCMV) criterion to ensure the satellite signals gain. The influence of interferences impinging elevation angles and polarizations on desired signals is also analyzed.

articleTitle: Design of a novel wideband high efficiency filtantenna array
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: A novel wideband high efficiency filtantenna array for space-borne synthetic aperture radar (SAR) applications is presented. The antenna array operating bandwidth is broadened by subarray technology, in which the subarrays are excited by a ridged waveguide divider. In order to eliminate the data transmission interference on SAR, the evanescent mode waveguide filters are integrated in the divider expediently. An X-band antenna array is designed, fabricated and tested. The measured suppressed level of the data transmission frequency is about 30 dB over the entire bandwidth, verified the design.

articleTitle: Unequal Y-power divider Kron-Branin model
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: An innovative Y-shape power divider (PWD) model is established based on the Kron-Branin formalism. The equivalent topology of Y-PWD is elaborated by considering the constituting elements of classical transmission line (TL). The S-parameter theoretical model is applied to single-input two-output (1:2) unequal Y-PWD. The unequal level of the outputs is controlled with output quarter wavelength branch characteristic impedances. The modelling concept feasibility is validated with a microstrip Y-PWD operating at about 2.45 GHz. The calculated and simulated S-parameters are in good agreement.

articleTitle: The application of sparse approximate inverse preconditioner in the fast solution of volume-surface integral equation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: When the multilevel fast multipole algorithm (MLFMA) is adopted to accelerate the solution of matrix equation generating by the volume-surface integral equation (VSIE), different submatrix-selecting schemes of near-field matrix preparing for constructing sparse approximate inverse (SAI) preconditioner are discussed. Numerical result indicates that for VSIE, a SAI preconditioner with high quality can be constructed by only using the surface-to-surface interaction part of the near-field matrix in MLFMA.

articleTitle: LCEC beamforming applied to a time-modulated array
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: An adaptive nulling scheme for a time-modulated array (TMA) based on Linearly Constrained Eigencanceler (LCEC) beamforming is introduced and investigated. Compared to conventional phased arrays, a TMA is potentially simpler to realize in hardware because it does not require a complex feed structure or phase shifters. LCEC is used in various application of array signal processing. And in this contribution we can apply it to the TMA. A example of 16 element linear TMA is analyzed using Fourier series and array factor theory. The adaptive beamforming of LCEC on TMA can be realized at harmonic frequencies. The simulation result is carried out to examine the performance of this beamforming system and compared to that of a conventional phased array.

articleTitle: A novel flower-shaped microstrip antenna for UWB communication
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: This paper presents a pattern of ultra-wideband microstrip antenna with the compact size of 36 × 43mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The antenna is printed on an Arlon AD270 (tm) dielectric plate with a relative dielectric constant of 2.2, consisting of a flower-shaped radiation patch and a ground plane Through Ansoft HFSS simulation, the result shows that the impedance bandwidth operates from 3.3 to 11.0 GHz and the antenna achieved an ultra-wideband impedance bandwidth (S11 <; -10dB) as high as 127.7%. These characteristics make the antenna suitable for UWB applications.

articleTitle: Multifunctional active frequency selective surface
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, we present a multifunctional active frequency selective surface (MAFSS), which consists of two metallic layers and a substrate layer. Three electromagnetic functions of switching, polarization selection and frequency tuning, are integrated into a single board. The bias networks are embedded in each layer and comprise the MAFSS elements themselves, which eliminates the need of extra feed lines for biasing active devices. In addition, a novel biasing topology is designed to bias different active components.

articleTitle: A wideband antenna loaded with ferrite for mobile phone applications
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, we proposed a novel mobile phone antenna with yttrium iron garnet (YIG) ferrite slab loaded to enhance antenna bandwidth. The antenna has an inverted-L shaped slot etched on the ground plane. The slot is fed by means of a 50 Ω microstrip connected to a bent strip. A step-shaped YIG ferrite slab is attached on the ground plane in the slot region to enhance bandwidth. The measured -6 dB band of the antenna without ferrite slab is 0.969-1.07, 2.25-3.36, and 4.25-5 GHz. With loading of ferrite slab, the bandwidth is enhanced to 0.667-1.0, 1.09-1.24 and 1.57-5 GHz.

articleTitle: An adjustable microstrip slot antenna using grapheme stacks
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, an adjustable microstrip slot antenna using graphene stacks is designed for terahertz applications. And the graphene stacks consist of graphene/Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> sheets, which are embedded in the microstrip substrate of the proposed antenna. According to simulation result, the frequency resonant bandwidth and radiation of the novel antenna can be dynamically modulated under different chemical potential.

articleTitle: An ultra-wide bandwidth absorber based on tightly coupled array
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: This paper designs an ultra-broadband absorber based on tightly coupled array (TCA), whose reflectance coefficient is expected to be below -10dB from 2.43GHz to 16.65GHz theoretically. It is found that the TCA absorbers are ultra-wideband, low-cost, low-profile, and conformable. The results of theory and simulation are given.

articleTitle: A point-by-point approach for fast and cost effective active millimeter-wave imaging
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: Sequent data acquisition and imaging in traditional active millimeter-wave imaging system in market results in serious time delay, cost, and system complexity. A point-by-point imaging approach is proposed in this paper to address the issue. Imaging starts shortly after data acquisition begins and virtually simultaneously with data acquisition. Partially known image and new data are used to image the remaining part of the concerned object. Simulation results show that the method is feasible.

articleTitle: A training sample detection method based on sparse recovery
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In order to solve performance reduction of space-time adaptive processing caused by interfering targets mixing in clutter training samples, a robust training samples detection method based on prior knowledge and sparse recovery is proposed. Firstly, the object region in unit to be detected is locked. Then the sparse complete base is got by discretizing the whole Angle-Doppler plane. After that, hollow out the corresponding object region in sparse complete base to estimate the clutter covariance matrix. Finally, the method is combined with generalized inner product method. Simulation analyses demonstrate the test statistics of proposed method have excellent discrimination validity, and can drastically eliminate interfering targets, which improves the target detection performance of STAP.

articleTitle: Preliminary consideration of imaging with MIMO synthetic aperture radars on small platforms
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: This paper presents our preliminary considerations on SAR imaging using small platforms. The motivation, the approach and the key techniques are discussed. The designing of codes transmitted from multiple transmitters, the distribution of antennas to avoid frequency ambiguity and the imaging method are discussed.

articleTitle: Etching process of multilayer refractory metal electrode based on reaction ion etching
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, the plasma etching process is applied to fabricate Ti/Pt/Au multilayer refractory metal electrode. By optimizing reasonable etching gas composition, the multi-component gas of Ar/Ar+Cl<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>+O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/Ar+CF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>+O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> is proposed to realize Ti/Pt/Au multilayer metal electrode accurately. The experiment result shows that good etching effect of multilayer refractory metal electrode is obtained by using three-step etching process.

articleTitle: Reflective metasurface for generating orbital angular momentum of microwave
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a reflective metasurface consists of 19 × 19 unit cells is designed, which can effectively convert general incident linear co-polarized wave to orbital angular momentum (OAM) with different modes. Using this reflective metasurface, we achieved OAM with mode 1, 2 and 3, and provides their phase and magnitude distribution in near field, as well as far field radiation pattern. Reflective beam is a vortex wave, and there is a distinct null at the center of the beam.

articleTitle: Dual-band suspended stripline filter based on metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a novel dual-band suspended stripline (SSL) filter is proposed. Based on traditional designing technique, a band-pass SSL filter is designed. Considering the unique properties of metamaterials, we apply it to the filter structure designing. Metamaterials can produce negative permittivity and thus there forms a dual-band. The simulated results exhibit low insertion loss, high selectivity and easy adjustability.

articleTitle: Triple-band GCPW rectifier for harvesting EM energy
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: A novel GCPW (Grounded Coplanar Waveguide) triple-band rectifier operating at 1.8GHz, 2.45GHz and 5.8GHz is proposed. The simulated maximum conversion efficiency at three frequencies are 73.1%, 65.2% and 54.9%, respectively. When the input power is 6dBm, the efficiency more than 50% covers bands from 1.4GHz to 2.5GHz and from 5.63GHz to 5.83GHz. The rectifier is suitable for harvesting EM energy on the low power density condition.

articleTitle: EM-driven size reduction of UWB antennas with ground plane modifications
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: This paper addresses a problem of size reduction of UWB antennas. We consider the effect of various ground plane modification on achievable miniaturization rate. In order to ensure that the optimum results are obtained, rigorous EM-driven design optimization is carried out involving all geometry parameters of the respective structures. Our investigations are performed using a representative set of four recent UWB monopoles and indicate a clear performance advantage of the elliptical ground plane slit over the rectangular one for all four types of antennas.

articleTitle: A 3D parabolic equation method for knife-edge diffraction modeling
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: A 3D parabolic equation (PE) method has been developed to model the propagation of electromagnetic waves over knife-edge obstacles on a perfectly conducting terrain. Under the assumption of forward propagation, the Helmholtz equation for each potential component could be approximated by a wide-angle PE. Then the split-step Fourier transform algorithm is used to march the potentials from one aperture plan to the next. Finally, in order to validate the proposed method, several numerical simulations of the diffraction of a knife-edge obstacle are made by using the 3DPE method, the 2DPE model and the Huygens-Fresnel principle respectively, and as a result, the examples demonstrate that the proposed 3DPE method performs well for knife-edge diffraction modeling.

articleTitle: A novel hierarchical foreign obeject debris detection method for millimeter wave radar
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: Millimeter wave (mm-wave) radar system is widely utilized in detecting the Foreign Object Debris (FOD) at the airport runways due to its high resolution and low power. In this paper, a novel hierarchical FOD detection method is proposed based on eigenvalue spectrum feature extraction and minimax probability machine (MPM) for a 77GHz mm-wave radar system. The clutter map constant false alarm rate (CFAR) detection technology is utilized firstly to categorize radar echoes into two classes, i.e., background clutter and the FOD returns (including the false alarm returns). Then eigenvalue spectrum features are extracted to transform the FOD returns and false alarm returns into the feature domain where they are more distinguishable. Finally, the MPM classifier is utilized to categorize the FOD and false alarm into different kinds so as to reduce the false alarm rate. Experiments results based on measured data show that the proposed method can achieve good detection performance.

articleTitle: Modified method of input SNR estimation for robust adaptive beamforming
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: The robustness of adaptive beamforming is relate to the input signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). In order to further improve the performance of input SNR estimation, a modified method of input SNR estimation for robust adaptive beamforming is proposed. Comparatively accurate value of the input SNR can be obtained by the proposed method, especially when the input SNR exceeds 0 dB. When the proposed method is used, the computational complexity of some robust adaptive beamfoming approaches can be further reduced. The validity of the proposed method is verified by simulation results, and the computational complexity is shown.

articleTitle: Size reduction of UWB antennas with performance constraints
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: Size reduction of ultra-wideband (UWB) antenna structures with taking into account matching, efficiency, and radiation pattern constraints is considered. We discuss design trade-offs between the minimum attainable antenna size and its electrical and field properties. The best possible trade-offs are obtained using rigorous numerical optimization of all geometry parameters of the structure at hand. Two examples of UWB monopole antennas are provided for the sake of illustration.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis on field-induced electromagnetic shielding material with two kinds of test device
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: Field-induced electromagnetic shielding material show an abrupt decrease of resistance when external electromagnetic field exceeds a threshold value, the material will occur metal-insulator transition phenomena in the nanosecond time, Owing to threshold value was so high that traditional static test method and low-voltage dynamic test can not satisfy test require. According impedance matching principle and time domain reflection, two kinds of dynamic test device are designed, the working principle of them are compared and analyzed, pulsed measurement show that the test device based on time domain reflection is more correct and directly.

articleTitle: Dual-band dielectric-loaded horn antenna for terahertz applications
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: A dual-band horn antenna operating at 94 GHz and 340 GHz is presented in this paper. The proposed structure consists of a corrugated conical horn and a tapered dielectric strip. The conical horn is responsible for 94 GHz, and is excited by vertical TE10 mode. The dielectric strip is inserted in the horn, which is responsible for 340 GHz, and is excited by horizontal LSM mode. Both of the two bands have equal beam-width in E-and H-planes. The proposed design has the merits of low cross polarization, high port isolation, and large frequency ratio. In addition, the gain in the two bands can be adjusted independently.

articleTitle: An improved equivalent circuit method for analyzing curved finite frequency selection surface
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: An improvement equivalent circuit method (ECM) for analyzing finite and curved frequency selection surface (FSS) is proposed in this paper, double-square-loop FSS has been used in the curved FSS and the transmission coefficients of both TE and TM models have been analyzed by the ECM and full wave method. It has been shown that the improvement ECM has saved computational time in designing curved FSS, and has verified its feasibility compared with the full wave EM method.

articleTitle: Densely packed MIMO antenna array integrated with compact resonator for high isolation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: This paper presents a densely packed MIMO antenna array with high isolation. A compact resonator as a band-gap filter is designed between the two patch antennas to enhance the isolation. Thanks to this compact resonator, the isolation between two patches can reach 30dB, nearly 20dB higher than the MIMO antenna array without using decoupling network. Furthermore, he bandwidth and radiation pattern of the proposed antenna array are nearly the same with the traditional one. Moreover, the envelope correlation coefficient of proposed antennas is smaller than −40 dB. Compared with the previous works, the elements spacing of the proposed antenna array is much smaller, about 0.04λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>.

articleTitle: Polarimetric-scattering-similarity in PolSAR denoising
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In polarimetric filters, the adjacent pixels in the same neighborhood are regarded as possessing similar scattering mechanism, and these pixels in the continuous window are usually selected to do the averaging process when filtering the central pixel. Considering the different similarity between each neighbor pixel and the central pixel, the averaging process is given by a new definition and used in the polarimetric filter. Because polarimetric scattering similarity (PSS) is used as a weight here, we call it PBW (PSS-based weight) in simple. Employing the PBW in the multi-look-like filters, we can get several improved results in polarimetric filtering by comparison experiments.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic wave interaction with plasma: Optimized slab design with transmission line theory
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: An optimized multiple layered plasma stealth model, with great electromagnetic (EM) wave absorption performance based on transmission line theory is proposed in this study. With employment of this multiple inhomogeneous layered plasma structure, EM waves absorption ability improves significantly compared with homogeneous ones. A wide EM wave frequency range, X band, interaction with this structure is analyzed, furtherly demonstrated its absorption ability. The analytical approach by this model is not able to describe the interaction mechanism between EM wave and plasma material precisely, but providing a straightforward, useful, and novel perspective on EM wave reflection minimization by plasma material to some extent.

articleTitle: Recognition of current transformer in infrared imaging based on K-means and morphological algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: Infrared imaging technology has gained more attention and become an interesting method in electrical maintenance. This paper proposes a novel method for current transformer recognition and location in infrared images. K-means algorithm is used in current transformer segmentation while an expansion-corrosion algorithm is applied to denoise and eliminate small pieces of equipment such as power lines. The results show that this method can detect current transformers in infrared images with complex background.

articleTitle: Ultra wide band-stop MEFSS with metamaterial characteristic
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a new MEFSS with metamaterial characteristic is proposed and its band-stop response is achieved from 1GHz to 10GHz. The proposed broadband MEFSS unit consists of four split rectangles and one I-shaped strip printed on one side of silicon substrate with very compact size. The effective permittivity or effective permeability of MEFSS unit is negative, so MEFSS is a metamaterial structure and has a broadband frequency band gap in the entire UWB range.

articleTitle: Calculation of transient responces of EMP on transmission lines
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: This paper presents analytical expressions and equivalent circuits for calculation of EMP responses (voltages or currents) on transmission lines. The analytical expressions are based on BLT equations, and equivalent circuits are based on telegraph equations and the controlled sources. Both methods are testified by experiments, and comparison of the two methods is discussed.

articleTitle: Wideband and high gain shared-aperture Fabry-Perot resonator microstrip antenna
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: A wideband and high gain shared-aperture Fabry-Perot resonator antenna is presented. Three different sizes of two-layer frequency selective surfaces are designed, as a shared-aperture configuration to form the metamaterial superstrate and load onto the antenna. By utilizing the phase compensation property along different FSSs, the antenna gain enhancement bandwidth is effectively broadened. After loading the superstrate, the antenna possesses a impedance bandwidth of 44.7% from 7.8GHz to 12.3GHz, covering the whole X band. From 7.9GHz to 12.1GHz, the antenna has an obvious gain enhancement, with a peak of 7dB. The results are validated by both numerical simulation and experimental measurements.

articleTitle: A wideband common-mode noise filter for differential signals using coplanar waveguide quarter-wavelength resonators
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: A wideband and low cost filter is presented for common mode noise (CMN) suppression in high-speed differential signaling. The filter is designed by etching coplanar waveguide quarter-wavelength resonators on the ground plane. An equivalent circuit model is given to predict CMN suppression performance of the proposed structure, which is in good agreement with the full-wave simulation and measurement. The CMN can be suppressed over 20 dB with fractional bandwidth of 71% by the two-coupled CPW quarter-wavelength resonators.

articleTitle: Analysis of mutual inductance between non-coaxial rectangular coils with rectangular cross-section
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: Magnetic coupling resonance wireless power transmission is a new technology to realize the wireless transmission of energy by means of high frequency coupling resonance between the coils. The variation of the coupling coil size and the relative position will change the mutual inductance between the windings, which will finally affect the characteristics of the infinite power transmission system. Using rectangular coil with rectangular cross-section as the analysis object, to research the calculation method of mutual inductance between non-coaxial rectangular coils, by subdividing and summation method to deduce the theory formula of the mutual inductance, to support wireless power transmission which consists of rectangular coils. In all cases, the formula programming calculation, the FEM software simulation and the experimental measurement results are consistent, which proves the correctness of the calculation method.

articleTitle: Nonlinear DC response in silver nanoparticles filled epoxy resin composites
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: The nonlinear response of silver nanoparticles filled epoxy resin composites under increasing applied voltage is investigated. The influence factors of applied high voltage on the conductivity of composites are measured by the collection of the electric current passing through the sample. With the increase of applied voltage, the composite has a nonlinear conductive characteristic. The contributing mechanism is tunnel effect which electrons can hop through the gaps and conductive paths are formed at the same time. From the perspective of the microstructure of composites, the conductive path is established by the quantum tunnel effect between nanometer silver particles. The influence factors on the conductivity of composites are discussed and analyzed.

articleTitle: Precision loss and its solution in calculation of EM wave propagation in plasma environment
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: This paper analyzed the precision loss problem in calculation of EM wave propagating in extreme plasma environment. To overcome the problem, a numerical calculation with arbitrary precision is proposed. The simulation results show the effect of computational precision loss on EM wave propagation and also illustrate the validity of the arbitrary-precision calculation method.

articleTitle: An 8-port planar UWB MIMO antenna for future 5G micro wireless access point applications
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: An 8-port planar UWB MIMO antenna is proposed for 5G micro wireless access point applications in this paper. The proposed antenna is formed by integrating three monopole strips with different structures and resonant modes, thereby resulting in a much wider bandwidth to cover UWB high band (5.15-10.6 GHz) with S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> lower than -10 dB. High isolation (lower than -15 dB) and low ECC (lower than 0.02) are obtained through diverse protruded stubs and etched slots loaded on the defected ground plane. Simulated results such as S-parameter, efficiency, gain, ECC, MEG and radiation pattern are presented and discussed.

articleTitle: Ka-band planar H-plane horn antenna based on the concept of complementary source
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: A substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) H-plane horn antenna loaded with dipole array is proposed. The horn antenna works with the gain from 9.0 to 11.7 dBi, high front-to-back ratio and stable radiation patterns in the entire Ka-band.

articleTitle: Study of tri-dipole broadband RFID near field antenna
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: A novel tri-dipole antenna used in UHF band near field RFID reader system is investigated. The new antenna achieves strong and uniform magnetic field distribution over 870MHz-940MHz which can cover the ETSI band of Europe and FCC band of the USA. The advantages of strong current and high efficiency could be achieved by this novel RFID reader antenna.

articleTitle: Numerical study on drastic-variation condition of electric field in microwave heating system
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: Microwave heating usually leads to non-uniform temperatures due to the existence of drastic variation of electric field. In this study, a numerical method combined with integral equation and spectrum analysis is proposed to find its generation condition. Results show that the electric field is generally unstable, and a tiny shift in microwave frequency, permittivity of dielectric object or cavity geometrical parameters will produce a drastic variation in electric field distribution, moreover, the smallest shift of parameter can be obtained by reverse search. FEM method is used to verify the conclusions.

articleTitle: Valence electron high-harmonic generation analysis by the finite difference time domain method
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: A finite difference time domain method is presented to analyze high-harmonic generation from single valence electron atom which is illuminated by a given strong ultrafast laser field. By invoking the finite difference time domain method, we discretize and solve the one-dimensional time-dependent Schrödinger equation to determine the corresponding wave functions, and calculation of high-harmonic generation spectra is derived. A numerical example of one-dimensional hydrogen atom model is given to verify the accuracy and feasibility of the proposed method. This method provides an effective approach in high-harmonic generation research from atom models.

articleTitle: Integrated structural design of a L-band multi-beam phased array antenna for satellite
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: A L-band multiple-beam phased array antenna with integrated structural design for satellite usage is described in this paper. By using the integrated design, the height of the filters and the LNA modules are reduced, and all the radiating elements and modules are assembled on one integral panel. Meanwhile, a solder-less junction structure is developed between the radiating elements and the filters. In this way, it is possible to realize the miniaturization and lightweight of the antenna.

articleTitle: Broadband dual-bandpass frequency selective surfaces based on intra- and inter-element couplings
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In this letter, we propose to design dual-bandpass frequency selective surface (FSS) based on both the intra- and inter-element couplings. To obtain the two broadband passbands, antisymmetric modes are introduced alternatively by intra- and inter-element couplings of the bi-layered structure. By retrieving the effective surface electromagnetic parameters, the transmission performance of the FSS is analyzed using the effective medium theory. A prototype was fabricated and measured. The experiment results are in good agreement with the simulation. The design method in this work provides an effective way of designing and analyzing multi-band FSSs.

articleTitle: Antenna reflector based on air loaded AMC strucuture
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: Based on the requirement of gain improvement and directivity in the wireless communication, we proposed a “V” antenna reflector, which belongs to a kind of artificial magnetic conductor (AMC). The reflector could be placed near the antenna and does not change the antenna's design. It contains two planar reflectors built from air loaded AMC units on two layer dielectric substrates. The gap of air loaded is used to fine tune the AMC working frequency. The experiments results show that the monopole 2.4GHz antenna's gain could increase 5dB in the opening direction and the beam width is about 52° with the “V” reflector.

articleTitle: Simulation study on compensating group delay distortion based on material dispersion
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In this study, we investigate the group delay distortion of a signal due to the presence of dispersion in transmission systems, and propose an approach to eliminate the distortion by dispersion compensation based on engineered material dispersion. We demonstrate that utilizing the anomalous frequency response of a dispersive material, envelope distortion of a signal passing through a given transmission system can be compensated, theoretical analysis and full-wave simulation agreeing well with each other.

articleTitle: Analysis of influence for sensitivity parameters under IEMI effects
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, the effects of intentionally electromagnetic interference (lEMI) such as high power microwave (HPM) and electromagnetic pulse (EMP) on several vulnerable semiconductor devices are characterized by their different damage mechanisms of external electromagnetic power. The emphasis is on the IEMI impact on the front end circuits which are most probability affected by the external injected signals. IEMI effects of PIN diode limiter and LNA base on BJTs are investigated numerically by our semiconductor simulator which is based on drift-diffusion model (DDM). The influences of rise time, amplitude and frequency of the interference signal are important for the IEMI effects according to the numerical results. Simulation result can be applied in damage mechanism analysis and harden design of circuit against the IEMI and other external electromagnetic interference.

articleTitle: Study of equivalent method on second-harmonic generation analysis by surface integral equation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: This paper concentrates on the surface integral equation (SIE) based on boundary equivalence principle evaluating second-harmonic (SH) generation from noble metal nanoparticles with arbitrary shapes. By invoking the proposed principle, the number of unknowns will reduce to half compared with the surface integral equation based on Love's equivalence principle with the same problem. Simultaneously, the source of second order nonlinear polarization treatment becomes more concise. Some numerical results show that the memory and computational time have been saved greatly. The method is validated by comparisons with the analytic SH-Mie solution to illustrate the accuracy.

articleTitle: MOD based TDIE-MNA method for solving hybrid field-circuit problems
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: An accurate marching-on-in-degree (MOD) scheme is proposed to solve the time-domain integral equation (TDIE) integrated with the modified nodal analysis (MNA) for simulating transient field-circuit coupling problems. In the MOD scheme, a set of weighted Laguerre polynomials is chosen as the temporal basis functions. Besides, the current continuity equation is modified for connecting the electromagnetic structures and circuit parts. Some numerical results are presented to demonstrate the accuracy of our MOD-based method.

articleTitle: Nonlinearity mitigation in vector mm-wave system
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a Volterra series nonlinear equalization (NLE) scheme is proposed to compensate the nonlinear distortions in vector mm-wave system over fiber link. The principle of NLE scheme is presented. The performance of NLE scheme is investigated through a 5Gbaud 16QAM over 40GHz RF carrier simulation system. The proposed NLE scheme is proved to be feasible in nonlinearity mitigation in vector mm-wave system.

articleTitle: A hybrid method for analyzing scattering from composite conductor and multiple dielectric objects
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: An efficient hybrid method of SJMCFIE combined single integral equation with the electric/magnetic current combined field integral equation is used for analysing scattering from composite conductor and multiple dielectric objects, in which, SIE can reduce one half unknowns in dielectric regions. SJMCFIE can greatly reduce the storage requirement. Moreover, Multilevel Fast Multipole Algorithm is employed to accelerate matrix-vector multiplications which can improve computation efficiency. Finally, some examples verify the validation of SJMCFIE-MLFMA, and indicate that this hybrid method is an effective tool in analysing multi-zone local coated conductor.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic scattering from simple target above composite rough surface of ground and near sea in adjacent region
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: The electromagnetic scattering characteristics of simple target above composite rough surface of ground and near sea in adjacent region are studied. Monte Carlo method is used to generate composite rough surface in which the Gauss spectral function is adopted to simulate the actual ground surface and the JONSWAP spectral function combined with shallowing coefficient is introduced to generate the actual near sea surface. Weighted inverse tangent function is presented to connect two regions and smooth the borderline. A cube target is considered above this kind of composite environment. The numerical results give the comparison of scattering characteristics between the simple target above the composite rough surface and the single rough surfaces, which can provide reference in the field of remote sensing and target detection.

Author Keywords: ground and near sea in adjacent region

articleTitle: An improved state space approach based method for extracting the target scattering center
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In accordance with the problem that it is difficult for radar simulator to load massive broadband frequency sweep data, this paper proposes an approach for extracting the wideband radar targets' scattering center parameters to reduce the storage requirement of frequency sweep data and solve the efficiency and precision problem of loading data. Firstly, resampling is conducted to echo signal in order to ensure uniform sampling of data. Then, the wideband scattering center model is transformed into statespace equations in order to estimate the location information of the scattering center through the simplified singular value decomposition (SSVD) and the spectrum estimation. Finally, the intensity of scattering center is calculated based on the maximum likelihood estimation method. The effectiveness of the approach is verified by computer simulation and it can provide a reference for the dynamic loading of simulator.

articleTitle: A novel medium-insensitive and dual-polarized chipless RFID tag antenna
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: This letter presents a novel medium-insensitive and dual-polarized chipless RFID tag antenna. The tag consists of nested concentric coplanar square loops, and adjacent loops are connected by two stub lines at the center of the opposite sides, respectively. The structure is designed to obtain the following function relationship between the loop number n and resonant mode number N: N=2(n-1). The proposed tag is magnetic, and the RCS magnitude is insensitive to the medium where it is pasted. The connected coplanar square loop resonators are reused in both vertical (V) and horizontal (H) polarizations to double the encoding capacity within a fixed bandwidth.

articleTitle: Defected ground structures for mutual coupling suppression and XP level improvement
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: A defected ground structure (DGS) is proposed to in this paper to reduce the mutual coupling between coplanar placed antenna elements. Another arc-shaped DGS under the antenna elements is also studied to reduce the cross-polarization (XP) level, because the DGS for mutual coupling suppression will increase the XP level unnecessarily. Using this method, both the mutual coupling suppression and the XP level improvement are achieved.

articleTitle: Design of a planar electrically small huygens source antenna
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: A 28 GHz, planar, electrically small Huygens source antenna is presented. The proposed antenna is composed of electric Egyptian axe dipole (EAD) and magnetic capacitively loaded loop (CLL) near-field resonant parasitic (NFRP) elements with a coax-fed dipole radiator. It has broadside radiating and planar performance characteristics. To confirm its efficacy for on-body applications, the specific absorption rate (SAR) values of the Huygens source antenna are evaluated and found to be very low.

articleTitle: A novel non-quasi-static large signal model FET assembled from small signal response
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: A new large signal model construction technique is proposed in this paper. High order current- and charge-sources are used to describe the dispersive behavior of FETs, which are assembled from small signal measurement data. Instead of storing the model data into look-up tables, empirical functions and artificial neural network (ANN) are adopted to implement the model into simulators, which can reduce the volume of the model, eliminate the oscillation caused by interpolation and provide better performance prediction outside the measurement range.

articleTitle: A novel pattern reconfigurable antenna composed of electric dipole vector antenna
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: A novel approach to design a pattern reconfigurable antenna element to extend the scanning range of phased array by adjusting the exciting amplitude of vector antenna is presented in this paper. A 2D and 3D vector antenna composed of orthogonal electric dipoles are simulated using CST software. Simulation results demonstrate the correctness of this approach.

articleTitle: Solving the Schrödinger-Poisson equation for simulating the nanoscale high electron mobility transistor using the finite difference method
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In recent years, the size of semiconductor structure has become so small that we have to take into account quantum effects. In this paper, the FDM is used to solve the Schrödinger-Poisson equations, because it has a better computing efficiency in one-dimentional situation. The precorrection is used to enhance the convergence of the two equations.

articleTitle: Mixed signal analysing based on phase Jitter
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In the process of location and rectification of signal source with exceeding radiation in electronic module or device, there constantly are signals mixing together in frequency domain, which could not be separated with the method of single-channel blind source separation (SC-BSS) effectively. For this issues that SC-BSS have no use in solving mixed signals, this paper proposes to separate mixed signals by means of random phase jitter, existing in most of signals sources or crystals and different from each source.

articleTitle: Simulation study of ionospheric turbulence based on finite-difference time-domain method
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: A modified finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method for full-scale simulation of the nonlinear interaction between electromagnetic (EM) waves and ionosphere is presented. The EM wave propagates from the neutral atmosphere into the ionospheric plasma. We observe Langmuir turbulence during the complex process and present electromagnetic field distribution at different time. This numerical study should be useful for understanding the nonlinear process of ionospheric turbulence.

articleTitle: Design of band-stop frequency selective surface structure with large and stable reflection band
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: A multi-layer frequency selective surface (FSS) with stable reflection properties was designed in this paper, which covers the wavelength range at Ku-band while transmits at other bands. It is obtained by having multi-layer to the periodic arrangement unit cell of the metallic Jerusalem Cross. Different distance of two layers and the size of unit cell also have great influence for its frequency response. Using this technique, the designed FSS show excellent and stable performance at different angles of incidence. Simulation and the results have been done.

articleTitle: Numerical de-embedding of propagation characteristics of EHi-mode microstrip line with periodical loading of shorting pins
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: Propagation characteristics including complex propagation constants and effective wave impedance of pins-loaded microstrip line under operation of the first higher-order EH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> mode are numerically de-embedded. Although numerous methods have studied the features of EH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>-mode, full-wave numerical extraction of the entire propagation characteristics of the pins-loaded EH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>-mode microstrip line is for the first time revealed. The algorithm is established by using three calibration standards, and then the two-port ABCD matrix of finite-cell pins-loaded microstrip line under EH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> mode is de-embedded to derive its complex propagation constants and effective wave impedance. Extensive investigations are executed by varying the pin diameters, and simple impedance transformers are then designed for verifying the extracted effective wave impedances.

articleTitle: Cross-polarized RCS computation with the vector parabolic equation method
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: The parabolic equation (PE) method is derived from the wave equation, and it has been widely used to solve electromagnetic wave propagation problems. In recent years, it was realized that the PE method can also be applied to scattering problems. The PE method meets the demand for higher efficiency and accuracy at the same time when there are limited computational resources. In this paper, both co-polarized and cross-polarized bistatic RCS of the electrically large targets can be calculated by the vector PE method.

articleTitle: An electromagnetic analysis method for modeling periodic organic solar structures
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: This paper proposes an effective electromagnetic analysis method for simulating periodic organic solar structures. The Finite Element Method (FEM) is derived to analyze the Organic Solar Cell (OSC), and the Periodic Boundary Condition (PBC) is enforced on the boundary of the OSC to model the infinite organic solar structure. So that the infinite organic solar structure can be solved by analyzing only an unit.

articleTitle: Analysis the electromagnetic properties of dielectric coatings with uncertain flaws using DGTD method
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In order to determine the acceptability of dielectric coating, uncertainties estimations of reflection coefficients are studied using discontinuous Galerkin time domain (DGTD) method. According to the probability statistic theory, the mean and variance of reflection coefficients are calculated. The computed quantities of interest are compared with analytic solutions, and good agreement for the statistics is observed, especially between the larger order of approximation and the number of elements, as demonstrated by the numerical experiments.

articleTitle: Object behavior evaluation based on wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In this work, we propose an object behavior evaluation system based on wireless sensor network. By the behavior information of objects contacted with human, it can evaluate the behavior characteristics of human under the interactions between human and environment, which goes beyond the traditional evaluation methods that directly monitor human themselves. The system can track and monitor the motion trail or vibration information of objects, the number of tracking objects can be up to 100 in local area. The evaluation of the indoor environment (a lab) has been realized in an experiment that shows the work time of the team in the lab.

articleTitle: Hybrid and integrated schottky diode based 330GHz and 420GHz subharmonic mixers
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: This paper describes the planar schottky diode based subharmonic mixers currently being developed at the EHF Key Laboratory of Fundamental Science of Universtity of Electronic Science and Technology of China. Hybrid and integrated GaAs Schottky diode based 330GHz and 420GHz subharmonic mixers are designed, fabricated and measured. Test results show that the minimum conversion loss of 330GHz monolithic integrated sub-harmonic mixer is 10.4dB at 328GHz, SSB conversion loss is less than 14.7dB from 320GHz to 340GHz when the LO power is 5mW; the minimum conversion loss of the 420GHz hybrid sub-harmonic mixer is 9.99dB at 406GHz, the SSB conversion loss is less than 15dB from 380GHz to 430GHz when the local power is 6dBm; the minimum conversion loss of the 420GHz heterogeneous integrated sub-harmonic mixer is 10dB at 419GHz and 422GHz, SSB conversion loss is less than 14.7dB over 400GHz to 440GHz frequency range when the LO power is 5.2dBm at 210GHz.

articleTitle: Fast scattering analysis of multiple objects by compressive sensing combined with biorthogonal lifting wavelet transform
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: For fast scattering analysis of multiple objects, the compressive sensing (CS) theory is introduced into method of moments (MOM). With the application of biorthogonal lifting wavelet transform(BLWT), an undetermined linear equation model is constructed by extracting the only several important rows of sparse impedance matrix in wavelet domain, then the unknown induced current is reconstructed by orthogonal matching pursuit (OMP) technique. Numerical results are presented to show effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A miniaturized, low-profile, self-actuated radome for EM protection
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a miniaturized, low-profile, self-actuated radome is designed for achieving field intensity dependent electromagnetic (EM) protection in a working frequency band. The radome is periodic with each unit loaded with four microwave diodes. The demension of the unit is in size of λ/12 and is ultrathin. A full-wave simulation is carried out for obtaining the transmission characteristic of the designed radome. Results show that the received field intensity by using the radome can be well controlled with a variable power loss from 0.1 dB up to 25 dB. Therefore, the radome is able to distinguish small signals from strong incident waves and can be utilized in EM protection against high power microwaves.

articleTitle: Study on the feasibility of EM scale model for the sea surface scattering using freshwater
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: The feasibility and error of the scale measurement in the laboratory using the freshwater to evaluate the scattering characteristics of sea surface are analyzed. By comparing the scattering coefficient and clutter time series between the scale model and prototype sea surface, it finds that using freshwater to do the scale measurement at moderate incident angle is feasible.

articleTitle: The design method of the ring-focus antenna forming ring beam
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In the systems such as satellite communication and mobile communication, the antenna with ring beam is needed. Based on ring-focus antennas, the antennas with ring beam with any departure angle can be realized. The design method of the antenna is provided and the formulae are derived strictly, then the real examples are computed, so the validity of the design method is testified. The antenna with ring beam has the advantages such as high gain and accurate beam direction.

articleTitle: Wideband LTCC vertical-fed dipole antenna for millimeter-wave applications
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: A 35-GHz wideband low-temperature co-fired ceramic vertical-fed dipole antenna is presented. The widened bandwidth of the dipole antenna is achieved by building two radiating dipoles. One dipole (dipole A) is fed by two signal vias directly, and the other one (dipole B), which is placed above dipole A, is fed by one arm of the dipole A through electrical coupling. The proposed dipole antenna has a simulated -10-dB |S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub>| bandwidth of 28.6% from 30 to 40 GHz. The simulated maximum gain of the dipole antenna is 6.2 dBi at 35 GHz.

articleTitle: Design of switch matrix used in V-band
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a switch matrix used in V-Band was proposed, which is composed of Single-Pole Double-Throw (SPDT) chip switch, power divider and matching load. One to sixty-four channels switch matrix network is designed with the type of waveguide to enhance the test flexibility of microwave system. The SPDT is controled by PC through USB port, the accomplished switch matrix with a new smaller structure has more channels than the classic switch matrix. The measured results show a return loss of -25 dB, isolation of greater than 25dB.

articleTitle: A broadband reflective fractal metamaterial polarization convertor
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, we designed, fabricated and measured a broadband reflective polarization convertor which can convert linear polarization to its orthogonal polarization from 6.8 to 16GHz, with a polarization conversion ratio larger than 86%. Because of its anisotropy, a nearly equal magnitude and a nearly 180° phase difference are generated along two orthogonal axes, which lead to the ability of polarization conversion.

articleTitle: Tunneling of spoof surface plasmon polaritons through effective epsilon-near-zero material
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, squeezing and tunneling of spoof surface plasmon polaritons (SSPPs) are realized by introducing an effective epsilon-near-zero (ENZ) material between two plasmonic waveguides constructed from dielectric filled rectangular waveguide etched with deep sub-wavelength periodical transverse slots on the upper wall. This simple design holds great promise in significantly increasing the propagation length or arbitrarily tuning the propagation direction of the SSPPs in the microwave and terahertz frequencies.

articleTitle: Terahertz high-efficiency high-gain plate antenna array
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, several Terahertz (THz) high-gain planar integrated antenna arrays developed in University of Electronic Science and Technology of China (UESTC) are introduced based on the diffusion welding technology. Thanks to their wideband, high-gain and compact configuration, these types of antenna arrays present excellent candidates for THz multi-gigahertz capacity wireless systems.

articleTitle: Multifunctional electromagnetic band gap structure with ultra wideband absorption and narrow band transmission properties
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In this letter, a multifunctional Electromagnetic Band Gap Structure (EBGS) with ultra wideband absorption and narrow band transmission properties is designed. It is constructed by two kinds of Frequency Selective Surfaces (FSSs) and a piece of dielectric spacer. The top FSS is a split square ring loaded with resistors, the middle is a dielectric spacer, the bottom is a slot ring FSS. Simulation shows the designed EBGS has very good absorptivity of 90% in the frequency band of 5.6–16.7 GHz, and has good transmission property of transmission loss about 0.47 dB at 21.4 GHz around. This EBGS can be used as stealth radome to reduce antenna Radar Cross Section (RCS).

articleTitle: Fractal UC-EBG structure and cross slot for mutual coupling suppression applications
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: A compact patch antenna array with high isolation by using two decoupling structures including a row of fractal uniplanar compact electromagnetic band-gap (UC-EBG) structure and three cross slots is proposed. Simulated results show that significant improvement in interelement isolation of 16dB is obtained by placing the proposed two decoupling structures. The design is easy to be manufactured without the implementation of metal vias and a more compact array with the edge-to-edge distance of 0.22λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> can be facilitated by a row of fractal UC-EBG, which can be well applied in the patch antenna array.

articleTitle: A dual-band integrated wireless energy harvesting system
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: This paper proposes a 2.45/5.8GHz simultaneously working dual-frequency rectenna for an integrated wireless energy harvesting system. A 2.45/5.8GHz receiving antenna is designed to receive RF (Radio Frequency) energy. To achieve a dual-frequency synchronized working rectifying circuits, a new design of 2.45/5.8GHz rectifying circuit utilizing reverse series output mode is proposed. With 0dBm input power, the simulated conversion efficiency of the rectifying circuit is higher than 60% and the measured conversion efficiency is higher than 20% when the dual frequency rectifying circuits work together. The rectenna is validated in an integrated wireless energy harvesting system. The measurement results show that the rectenna can be used to harvest energy for low-power electronic devices.

articleTitle: Influence on aircraft dynamic RCS statistical characteristics from flight speed
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In order to study the influence on the statistical distribution characteristic of dynamic radar cross section (RCS) from aircraft flight speed, firstly through analyzing aircraft aerodynamic, setting track model, calculating attitude angle and electromagnetic simulation, the three groups of dynamic RCS sequence were obtained under different flight speed. And the fitting curves of dynamic RCS sequence were simulated based on Chi-square model and Log-normal model, finally the Kolmogorov-Simonov test was proposed to calculate the fitting goodness. The results show that different flight speeds can have an influence on the statistical distribution characteristic of dynamic RCS, and the faster flight speed is, the larger the fitting error would be.

articleTitle: A review of terahertz imaging systems in CMOS
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In the last decade, the research on terahertz imaging systems in CMOS has attracted extensive attention and gained rapid progress. Detection theory and performance indicators are first analyzed in this paper. System structures are then compared from three aspects. Finally, research progresses are reviewed and certain research directions are indicated on account of existing problems.

articleTitle: A broadband AMC-based reflector for RCS reduction
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: Based on the reflecting phase properties of the artificial magnetic conductor (AMC), a broadband low radar cross-section (RCS) reflection screen is designed by combining two types of AMC cells in a novel pattern in this paper. By partially modifying AMC units on the diagonal of the traditional chessboard patterned AMC blocks, the AMC-based reflective screen is designed. Simulation results show that the proposed reflecting screen has a broadband property (relative bandwidth of 48.1%) in which −10dB RCS reduction is obtained comparing to a metallic plate with the same size.

articleTitle: A new method for indoor non-rhythmic human motions classification using ultra-wideband radar
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In order to classify non-rhythmic human motions by ultra-wideband (UWB) radar, a weighted rang-time-frequency transform (WRTFT) method is proposed to extract both Doppler and range features. And the bootstrap-aggregated decision trees (Bagged Trees) classifier is utilized to recognize each non-rhythmic human motion. Experiments show that the proposed method can achieve 92.9% classification accuracy for recognizing seven typical non-rhythmic activities.

articleTitle: A polarization reconfigurable magneto-electric dipole antenna
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: A novel polarization reconfigurable aperture-coupled magneto-electric (ME) dipole antenna is presented. By electronically controlling the state of switches between square patches and an additional strip of the ME dipole, the antenna is capable of switching the polarization among one linearly polarized (LP) and two orthogonal circularly polarized (CP) states. An overlapped bandwidth of 16% from 5.07 to 5.95 GHz for both -10 dB and axial ratio (AR) ≤ 3 dB. A measured gain of approximately 8.2 dBi and a radiation efficiency of approximately 85% over the overlapped band are obtained for all polarization states. Moreover, the proposed design is able to realize stable radiation patterns with both cross polarization and back radiation levels lower than -13 dB.

articleTitle: Transmission bandgap of a two-dimensional coaxial Bragg structure with hybrid filling media
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: The transmission characteristics of a two-dimensional coaxial Bragg structure have been investigated in this paper. The dielectric layer between the outer and the inner conductors of the coaxial waveguide in the structure is helically corrugated and the grooves are loaded with a metallic strip. It is found that, a dominant transmission bandgap can be obtained from the mode conversion induced by the axial and azimuthal periodicities of the hybrid filling media, and its location can be controlled by the axial period of the helical grooves. These peculiarities can be employed in the applications of tunable notch filters, high-ß resonators, mode converters and etc.

articleTitle: Design of compact RFID tag antenna mountable on metallic surfaces
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In this work, a compact tag antenna based on loop structure is proposed for radio frequency identification (RFID) system. The tag has a small overall size of 55 mm × 41.5 mm × 3 mm, with a single conductor layer for lower cost and easy fabrication. Simulation results show that the antenna has a 3 dB bandwidth of 30 MHz when placed on a 200 mm×200 mm metal plate. The antenna can also be mounted on dielectrics with low permittivity. The antenna has a relatively long reading range when placed in different environments, indicating its wide applications.

articleTitle: Fast parameter scanning method for printed circuits based on matrix high-dimensional interpolation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, one fast method for analyzing printed circuits based on matrix high-dimensional interpolation schemes has been presented. By virtual of the bi-interpolation on the plane of the frequency direction and the dielectric constant direction, the proposed method can greatly reduce the global time consuming of matrix fillings, and it can greatly improve the efficiency of multi-parameter scanning. The numerical example provided shows the accuracy and the efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Statistical expression for the law of reflection by PSO
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: The law of reflection is the basic experimental law in college physical course. According to the Fermat principle of the Geometric Optics theory, particle swarm optimization algorithm(PSO) is used to search for the point position on the plane. By regression analysis and significance test on a large number of samples, the law of reflection is verified. The method is helpful to the revolution for the physics teaching, and students can pay attention to the physical phenomenon itself and accurately construct physical model.

articleTitle: Synthesis of reflection-type phase modulator with constant group time delay using cascading dipoles
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: Based on dispersion engineering of the electric dipoles, we design a tunable reflection-type phase modulator(PM) with constant group delay time(GDT). The PM is demonstrated a high coupling efficiency and good linear phase reflective response in 8.4-11.4GHz. The time-domain response is also analyzed, which presents a coherent result with frequency responses. The PM can be used to design achromatic components. Transmission-type phase modulator also can be designed with same method.

articleTitle: Design of Ka-band active phased-array antenna for GEO communication satellite payloads
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: This paper determines the number of elements required for the phased array fed dual reflector antenna system for limited scan coverage under the condition of grating lobe-free in real-space. The design results of radiation performance of the dual reflector antenna with direct radiation phased-array feed are introduced according to the key specifications of antenna at Ka-band.

articleTitle: A novel high gain polarization conversion metasurface
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: A novel structure of meta-surface with the function of high gain polarization conversion is proposed and studied. The meta-surface consists of 16 radiating elements, which are 4×4 periodically arranged under the Rogers substrate. In this paper, the high gain and radiation conversion mechanism of meta-surface are analyzed from the aspects of transmission phase and transmission amplitude of the microwave. Its equivalent circuit model is proposed and developed.

articleTitle: A simple and efficient on-board calibration method of satellite phased array antenna
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In satellite phased array antennas, some mechanical distortions and ageing and thermal variation will cause significant degradations of the electrical performances. In this paper, a simple on-board calibration method is proposed for these variations, which can be attained by an on-board measurement and treatment system. The method is validated by experiments and its results are also evaluated. The proposed method can attain theoretically-predicted calibration accuracy.

articleTitle: Analysis of axially displaced ellipse reflector antennas by using HFSS-PO hybrid method
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a novel hybrid technique for radiation pattern computation of an Axially Displaced Ellipse (ADE) is proposed and demonstrated. The proposed technique employs the combination of HFSS and Physical Optics (PO). As a result, a highly accurate radiation pattern has been obtained using our method. Because computation time and memory usage of this technique are much less than that of other full-wave analyses, the proposed method can be applied to a large aperture reflector antenna analysis.

articleTitle: Wide band implantable antenna operating at MedRadio band for MBAN devices
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: This paper proposed a miniaturized wideband implantable antenna operating at MedRadio band for Medical Body Area Network (MBAN) devices. The operating frequency of the proposed antenna covers from 334 to 441 MHz for the simulated result, which is robust enough to withstand the frequency shift brought by different human beings. The footprint of the designed antenna covers a planar area of only 14 mm × 9.6 mm, making it easily implantable in future MBAN devices for health monitoring purposes.

articleTitle: Improved feature selective validation in evaluating uncertainty analysis results in EMC simulation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: The paper proposes a novel validity evaluation method, Improved Feature Selective Validation, in order to evaluate the uncertainty analysis results in Electromagnetic Compatibility simulation.
