publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: For nonlinear analysis of microwave circuit, the conventional full-wave field-circuit coupled algorithm based on time domain volume surface integral equation (TD-VSIE) is usually employed. As a result of the existence of nonlinear equations, the Newton iteration solution is used. In this paper, Thevenin's theorem is applied to combine with field-circuit coupling algorithm based on TD-VSIE for analyzing the microwave amplifier circuit. Compared with the conventional method, the proposed method can efficiently reduce the computing time.

articleTitle: A new combined rotating-element electric-field vector(REV) calibration method for large phased array antenna
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: A new combined REV calibration method for large phased array antenna is presented in this paper. This method is based on power measurement, so the measurement can reach a high stability in high frequency. It can also improve the calibration accuracy and efficiency at the same time, especially in large phased array antenna. Simulation results testify the correctness of this new method.

articleTitle: A study on RF discharge characteristics of argon in multi-physics field
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: Belongs to the problem of discharge hazards together with ESD, RF discharge, whose characteristics are influenced by different experimental conditions, is studied. The conclusions of RF discharge characteristics of argon are given through theoretical analysis and multi-physics simulation.

articleTitle: A broadband low-RCS aperture-coupled microstrip antenna
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: A novel design of aperture-coupled microstrip antenna with broadband low radar cross section (RCS) is proposed. Hybrid frequency selective surface (FSS) structures consisting of two kinds of polarization-dependent folded split ring resonators (PDFSRRs) and square patches are utilized to replace the conventional metallic ground. By orthogonally arranging the PDFSRRs in a chessboard-like configuration, the band-stop characteristic contributes to the gain enhancement, while the zero degree points of reflection phase are utilized to achieve RCS reduction both in-band and out-of-band. Full wave simulations demonstrate that the proposed antenna achieves RCS reduction from 1GHz to 18GHz compared with traditional microstrip antenna.

articleTitle: External RF electromagnetic environment testing system with two type of antennas
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, we used two type of high gain antennas in external RF electromagnetic environment (EME) testing system which was the most important part in the electromagnetic environment effects (E3) system testing. The first one was S band pyramidal horn antenna had wider beam width in 2GHz to 4GHz, and the other one was parabolic antenna had higher gain in the same frequency band. From using these two different antennas in irradiation in open area test sites (OATS), we found two methods to operate this test which had invariable radiation distance or invariable radiation area to adapt different type of system under test (SUT).

articleTitle: Radiated fields of a high-speed moving dipole at oblique incidence
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a three-dimensional Lorentz-FDTD method has been presented to analyze the radiated fields of a high-speed moving dipole at an oblique incidence. By comparing the numerical results and the analytical results, the accuracy and validity are verified.

articleTitle: A miniaturized antenna applied for biomedical applications
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: We present a miniaturized antenna applied for biomedical applications. The key to communicate with the external devices is the antenna design. Meanwhile, a multilayered PIFA antenna operating at 433MHz industrial, scientific and medical (ISM) band with the gain of -28dBi is proposed. In antenna simulation, we simulate the antenna inside capsule system composed of capsule shell, and circuit equivalent to pec into a cubic phantom mimicking human muscle environment.

articleTitle: Modeling and electromagnetic scattering of composite rough surface of island in deep sea
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: A novel composite rough surface model is presented for describing island in deep sea. Monte Carlo method is used to generate composite rough surface. Gauss spectral function is used to simulate actual ground surface of island. Pierson-Moskowitz (PM) spectral function is used to simulate actual sea surface of deep sea. Based on the theory of composite rough surface modeling, weighted inverse tangent function is presented to connect two regions and smooth the borderline. The curves of bistatic scattering coefficient of ground, deep sea and composite rough surface are compared. This paper presents a novel way to simulate the environment of island in deep sea. Simulation results can use for reference in the fields of remote sensing, detection and inversion of electromagnetic environment.

articleTitle: Study of scattering from two-layered soil surfaces with object buried between two rough interfaces
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: Electromagnetic scattering from two-layered rough soil surfaces with object buried between the two rough interfaces is investigated utilizing method of moments (MoM). Theoretical formulas of the scattering model considered in this paper are presented and the surface electric current and surface magnetic current are numerically calculated by employing MoM with point matching and pulse basis functions. The influence of rough surface characteristic parameters and medium relative permittivity on bistatic scattering coefficient is discussed in detail.

articleTitle: Electron analysis of a deep sub-micrometer MOSFET device based on spectral element method
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, the spectral element method is used to build a hydrodynamic model in order to solve the semiconductor transient simulation. The hydrodynamic model consists of five nonlinear differential equations: the electron current continuity equation and hole current continuity equation, electron energy-balance equation, hole energy-balance equation and Poisson's equation. Unlike the drift-diffusion(DD) model, the hydrodynamic model can simulate the deep sub-micrometer device to get more accuracy results than the DD model.

articleTitle: A novel symmetrical composite right/left handed meta-material unit cell for antenna designing
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In this study, a novel symmetrical composite right/left handed meta-material unit cell is proposed. It is designed based on a circular microstrip patch which is able to work in either the left-hand region or the right-hand region. The phase constant of the unit cell is investigated. It is utilized to design a patch antenna, realizing dual-band radiation modes in a much smaller size compared to the traditional one. The unit cell can also be considered as a periodic element to construct 1-D periodic leaky wave antenna.

articleTitle: Calculate for circuit model of 1000A/75mV shunt based on field-circuit coupling method
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, the circuit model of 1000A/75mV shunt was calculated based on field-circuit coupling method by designing an interactive computer program between numerical analysis in MATLAB and finite element analysis in ANSYS. The calculate results provide the basis to analyzing measurement results when measuring transient current or alternating current with shunt.

articleTitle: The analysis of two dimensional high-order hierarchical basis function in DGTD method
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: Based on one dimensional first-order basis function, the construction process of the second and third-order scalar hierarchical basis functions in two dimensional case is given. The second and the third-order basis functions are applied to discontinuous Galerkin time domain (DGTD) algorithm. The influence of order of the basis function in accuracy of DGTD is analyzed.

articleTitle: A novel tunable wide-band FSS with varactors
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: A novel tunable frequency selective surface is presented in this paper. The FSS is composed of two stacked metallic layers. By loading different capacitance or inductance, resonant frequency can be easily changed. The simulation results show that when the capacitance is loaded, the resonant frequency can be decreased from 5.8 GHz to 4.7 GHz when the capacitance is increased from 0.1pf to 0.3pf. When the inductance is loaded, the resonant frequency will be decreased from 8.9GHz to 8.3GHz when the inductance is increased from 2nH to 4nH. Resonant frequency can be optimized easily by changing the loaded varactors. A parametric analysis of the novel FSS is undertaken in HFSS simulation software.

articleTitle: A thin dielectric sheet integral equation method for anisotropic medium
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: When graphene is biased by a magnetostatic field, the impedance surface is anisotropic with tensor conductivity and tensor dielectric permittivity. The analysis of graphene biased by a magneto static field is different from that graphene biased by an electric field and is more complicated. In order to deal with this situation, the method of integral equation of thin dielectric sheet for anisotropic medium is introduced. The numerical results show that the results are in good agreement with the result in reference.

articleTitle: Research on the locating indoor based on the time reversal mirror
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: A method of RF locating in complex environment indoor based on the time reversal mirror (TRM) is introduced. TRM approach utilizes the reciprocity of the transmitting and receiving channel. This method can overcome the multi-path and eliminate the time delay caused by the complex environment. In this paper, the FDTD method is used to simulate the signal source emission in the simulation space, and then the received signal is time-reversed and retransmitted in the receiving array position. The location of signal source is estimated by monitoring the distribution of electromagnetic field in time and space. The simulation results show that the time reversal signal achieves a focus at the signal source and gets a good indoor positioning effect.

articleTitle: A study on THz array radar imaging method
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: Terahertz (THz) radar has developed a lot in recent years. Its ability for near field security inspection becomes a popular research topic. However, the phase errors caused by THz radar's motion are difficult to compensate due to the submillimeter wavelength, which means a tiny motion error will bring a huge phase deviation. In this paper, we report a crossed array radar imaging method, which employs fixed TX- and RX-elements collecting real-time data to avoid the phase errors caused by radar's motion. The imaging reconstruction are deduced in matched-filter and spatial frequency domain approach. Furthermore, the numerical simulation results are conducted to demonstrate the performance of this imaging method.

articleTitle: Fast and accurate calculation of sea echo Doppler spectrum in high frequency band
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: Since multilevel fast multipole algorithm (MLFMA) is the most effective method for the exact solution of scattering characteristics of electrically large objects, MLFMA is applied to two-dimensional sea surface scattering in high frequency (HF) band in this paper. Firstly, dynamic ocean surface modeling and incident wave form selecting are discussed, which should be considered especially for sea surface scattering using MLFMA. Then sea echo Doppler spectrum of HF radar is simulated. Results show that there are obvious first-order, second-order and third-order peak in the Doppler spectrum. And the positions of these peaks are consistent with the theoretical results based on Bragg scattering mechanism of sea surface in HF band. At the same time, the intensity difference between the first-order peak and the second-order peak is consistent with actual situation.

articleTitle: EM analysis of PEC object above halfspace by using higher-order hierarchical vector basis functions
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a set of higher-order hierarchical divergence-conforming vector basis functions based on curved triangular patches is presented for EM scattering analysis of PEC objects above a lossy half space. Numerical examples are presented to demonstrate the valid and efficiency of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Large-signal modeling of GaN devices with emphasis on trapping effect and simulation validation (Invited)
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: This paper will present the recent development of large-signal modeling cum PA design based on Dynax GaN HEMT devices. A modified Angelov model is used to model the pulse I-V data. Improved modeling results to address the trapping effect will be given together with new model parameter extraction methodology. A new Large Signal model purpose with trapping effect. Design Power Amplifier in the purpose model and compare with the measurements with old large signal model.

articleTitle: On the phase selection of millimeter wave quantized reflectarrays
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: Microstrip printed reflectarrays are becoming a potential replacement of parabolic reflector and phased array antennas due to their simple design, low cost and ease of manufacture to attain high gain and wide angle beam pointing at millimeter waves (mm-waves). Significant challenges are faced while implementing continuous phase reflectarrays at mm-waves. However, discretizing the required reflection phase provides a practically implementable solution. This contribution addresses the selection of phase states and its scattering in a phase discretized mm-wave reflectarray. The performance of two 1.5 bit phase quantized reflectarrays having closely spaced geometrical features is analyzed at 60 GHz. This study provides a better understanding to achieve a wider bandwidth response in practically implementable mm-wave reflectarrays.

articleTitle: A novel dual-stop-band FSS for infrared stealth application
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In this paper we propose a new dual-stop-band frequency selective surface (FSS) for infrared stealth applications. The simulated results show that the proposed dual-stop-band FSS has high reflectivity in the two atmospheric windows (3.0-5.0μm and 8.0-14.0μm) for normal incidence waves, and the transmissvity is suppressed completely under 0.1.

articleTitle: Subwavelength metamaterial unit for the applications of compact microstrip filters and diplexers
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: This paper presents a set of compact microstrip filters and diplexers based on the subwavelength metamaterial unit. Such metamaterial unit is developed from the classic split ring resonator by extending and bending the wire and shorting one of the end to ground. Firstly, the microstrip filter consisting of two metamaterial units and the diplexer based on the obtained filter are demonstrated experimentally. Then the performance enhanced designs based on four metamaterial units are designed and investigated.

articleTitle: A soft source technique introduced to the ADI-PSTD method
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: Soft source consisting of impressing a current has been successfully added to the pseudospectral time-domain (PSTD) method in this approach. Its physical meaning well understood has been with analytical solution, and applied to numerical PSTD method. In order to increase computational efficiency, the alternating-direction-implicit (ADI) technique is used. Compared to the hard source consisting of impressing an electric field, soft source as an excitation is proposed for solving Maxwell's equations. A significant computational advantage has been found. Only two grid points per minimum wavelength are required in the PSTD method, a half of time steps is required to process whole computation in the ADI method. Far less memory and time is required, and much more efficient has been obtained than traditional FDTD.

articleTitle: Mechansim analysis and verification of out-of-band interference effects of communication station
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: The communication station will automatically shut down when disturbed strongly by the out-of-band continuous wave, and the station can restart automatically when the interference is eliminated. There are two assumptions about the mechanism of the out-of-band restart phenomenon: one is that the restart effect is related to the peak-to-peak value of the interfering signal, and the other is the power of the restart signal. Derive the amplitude relationship between sinusoidal continuous wave and sine amplitude modulation wave under different assumptions, and then use the communication station for out-of-band interference test. The experimental results show that the out-of-band restarting effect of the communication station is related to the power of the interfering signal.

articleTitle: Dual-band dual-sense circularly polarized annular ring slot antenna
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel dual-band dual-sense circularly polarized (CP) annular ring slot antenna. The antenna consists of two concentric annular ring slots to achieve dual-band operation. The dual-sense circular polarization can be obtained by loading proper lumped capacitors across the inner and outer slots at +45° and -45°, respectively, with respect to the microstrip feed line. An antenna prototype was implemented and measured to validate the design concept, showing that the antenna achieves good left-hand circular polarization (LHCP) for the lower band and right-hand circular polarization (RHCP) for the upper band. The measured 10-dB impedance bandwidths are about 21.5% and 22.5%, respectively, for the lower and upper bands. The measured 3-dB axial ratio (AR) bandwidths are nearly 3.7% and 5.8% for the lower and upper bands, respectively.

articleTitle: Study on spatial magnetic field intensity distribution of rectangular permanent magnets based on Matlab
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: The magnetic field of the permanent magnet is closely related to its shape and position. In this paper, the magnetic field intensity distribution of a single rectangular permanent magnet is analyzed by means of Matlab software, which is based on the equivalent magnetic charge method. The effect of the size of the rectangular permanent magnet on the magnetic field distribution determines the area of the magnetic field.

articleTitle: A millimeter-wave half-waveplate based on field transformation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, we proposed a half-wave plate, which works at millimeter-wave band, based on a field transformation(FT) method with wide incident angle and broad working bandwidth. The proposed waveplate is composed of periodically arranged two dielectric layers with sub-wavelength heights. The effective electromagnetic(EM) parameters of the proposed waveplate can be tuned by manipulating the heights of the two dielectric layers. As a result, a broadband EM half-waveplate is achieved in millimeter-wave region, which obtains 90% conversion efficiency across the frequency band from 24 to 37 GHz. The performance of the waveplate is verified through full-wave simulation. Such half-waveplate can be easily realized through 3D printing technology.

articleTitle: Simulation of plasma sheath and scattering property of a hypervelocity reentry object
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: A simulation procedure of the plasma sheath and its scattering property by a hypervelocity object is presented. First, the simulated electron density and gas temperature of the plasma sheath are found in reasonable agreements with experiment results. Then the complex dielectric constants of the plasma domain are calculated by using the simulated flow field data. Finally, the influence of the plasma sheath on the backscattering property is evaluated for an incident plane wave at 1 GHz.

articleTitle: Design of polarization conversion metasurface by using high-permittivity ceramics
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, we design an all-dielectric polarization conversion metasurface using high-permittivity ceramics. The metasurface is composed of 2D arrays of ceramic resonators. A nearly 1 GHz polarization conversion is demonstrated in 3.68-4.64GHz. Since such polarization conversion metasurface are made of high-permittivity ceramics, they are of important values in high-temperature or high-power applications. The method can also be used to design all-dielectric polarization conversion metasurface in other frequencies.

articleTitle: A hybrid approach of satellite footprint pattern synthesis for time-modulated arrays
publicationTitle: 2017 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES)
abstract: A hybrid approach based on alternative projection method (APM) and differential evolution (DE) algorithm for satellite footprint pattern synthesis of time-modulated arrays (TMAs) is proposed in this paper. Satellite footprint pattern at the center frequency is synthesized by APM firstly, and then sideband level (SBL) is suppressed by DE. To verify the approach, a planar array more than 1500 elements with low dynamic range ratio (DRR) of amplitude excitations is synthesized. Simulation results validate its superior performance.
